== Title ==
<span lang="ja">インペリアル・ウォーカー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1名のパイロットと8名の乗客を搭乗させられる。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">4本足の密閉型戦闘用ビークル。巨体を揺るがせて迫り来るＡＴ－ＡＴ（全地形対応装甲トランスポート）は、完全武装の兵員をまるまる1個大隊、輸送することができる。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Imperial Walker.

'''Lore''' — Four-legged enclosed combat vehicle. The looming AT-AT (All Terrain Armored Transport) can carry an entire battalion of fully armed soldiers.

'''Game text''' — May carry one pilot and eight passengers. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

The Japanese lore says battalion where the English lore says squadron. The passenger capacity, pilot capacity and permanent pilot’s ability agree.<ref>[[:File:ESB2P-D-imperialwalker.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Walker]].</ref>
